rule: For head degree 1..4 use u16 refs at +2 onward. For head degree 5..7 use three u16 refs at +4/+6/+8 then degree-3 u16 refs at +0 onward of next physical Section4 record. Consume/skip that continuation record; do not interpret its first byte as degree. +2 of high-degree head remains opaque. Do not merge nodes by coordinates.
holdout: blocks>=20 with no main OR secondary coordinate shared with any discovery-block main/secondary coordinate. Conservative coordinate exclusion for leakage prevention only, not node identity. Quarantine excluded neighboring blocks.
verification: derive exact primary endpoint incidence independently from Section5 index and 0x1000/0x2000 table selectors; compare multisets; compare continuation coverage against old 511/1325 anomalies. No test-driven rule changes.
